name: Roncegno Terme (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Roncegno Terme (a white cross on blue with the letters C R V M) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Roncegno Terme, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Roncegno Terme arms — white cross on blue with the letters C R V M, crowned, within branches
